source: Continuation of requested conversational number practice
lessonTheme: Cien versus ciento in prices and after mil
summary: Cien before tens recurred in 170 and 180 despite a correction; focused ciento ochenta retry then full 190 were correct. Correct contrast with exactly cien euros, followed by mil ciento ochenta transfer after thousand models.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de cien setenta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de ciento setenta euros.
observations.outcome: Cien used for 170; corrected to ciento before the rest of the number.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de cien ochenta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de ciento ochenta euros.
observations.outcome: Cien error recurred for 180 after correction; ciento explained and focused retry requested.
Correct focused immediate retry with starting word ciento supplied; not independent recall.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de ciento noventa euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de ciento noventa euros.
observations.outcome: Correct full-sentence transfer to 190 after focused retry.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de cien euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de cien euros.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de mil ciento ochenta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de mil ciento ochenta euros.
observations.outcome: Correct transfer to 1180 after models mil cien for 1100 and mil ciento noventa for 1190.

nextSteps: Recheck cien versus ciento after a gap, including 100/180 and 1100/1180.
Retain earlier spelling reviews seiscientos, setecientos and cincuenta.
Continue task-relevant number practice without assuming long-term mastery.
assessmentNote: Focused retry used a supplied starting word. Full-sentence transfers were immediate; no independent delayed retention inferred.
